title: Pelion Space Analytics
summary: Web services and dashboard for thermal-camera and PIR occupancy sensing.

dates.note: Within January 2019–April 2020 graduate role; exact project dates are unspecified.

facts.text: Built a Node.js/Express REST backend for occupancy data from thermal-camera and PIR sensors.
Defined and implemented PostgreSQL schemas and performed database performance testing.
Implemented React JavaScript and CSS dashboard components and configured Auth0 authentication.

notes: Performance testing is documented; no measured database performance improvement is supplied.
